name: Kaleb Rennemann
career_history: Director of Preconstruction at Serverfarm, 1/2026 to present; Senior Manager of Construction at Blue Origin, 1/2023 to 12/2026; Principal | Bluewater Building and Development, CBC at Bluewater Building and Development, 1/2020 to 12/2023; Construction Manager at Whiting-Turner Contracting, 1/2018 to 12/2020; Licensed Florida Real Estate Broker at Florida, 1/2014 to present; Intelligence Analyst at US Army, 1/2012 to 12/2014
biography: Building Teams. Delivering Projects. Developing Leaders. Kaleb is a construction, infrastructure, and development leader who believes leadership is earned through trust, not authority. Over the course of his career, he has led teams responsible for more than $3 billion in capital construction and infrastructure programs across complex, mission-critical environments. His experience spans strategy, development, design, construction, commissioning, and operational turnover, consistently aligning people, partnerships, and execution to deliver lasting results. Known for building high-performing teams and developing future leaders, Kaleb has earned a reputation for creating cultures rooted in accountability, ownership, and trust. He believes the strongest organizations are built when people are empowered, commitments are honored, and leaders invest as heavily in their teams as they do in the work itself. While projects and facilities stand as visible accomplishments, Kaleb believes leadership is ultimately measured by the trust earned, the relationships built, and the people left better than they were found.
